subject: mathematics
concept: Calculating the mean (average) of a small data set
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student redistributes virtual object stacks of different heights until they're all equal, to find the average
exercise.pictorial: Student uses a bar model to find the mean of a pictured data set
exercise.abstract: Student calculates the mean by summing values and dividing by the count

misconception_flags: divides by the wrong count (e.g. forgets to count all data points)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
